name: Talarion
description: Talarion keeps AI current. Frontier models don't know about recent events, and web search can't answer questions LLMs don't know to ask. Talarion proactively tells your AI what it's missing before it starts researching to prevent critical omissions and judgement errors. Install the MCP to make sure your AI assistant knows what it would otherwise be missing.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Talarion to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Talarion to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.talarion.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Talarion MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Talarion provides these MCP tools: feedback and research_brief.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Talarion?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to Talarion in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.
Talarion requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Talarion is developed by Talarion, Inc.. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
